EpochAge.tooltip: Time between the simulation and the element set epoch. Aging past 3 days, old past 7, very old past 14: positions drift further from reality the older the elements are.

toast.poor: Elements are more than 14 days old at this time. Positions may be off by tens of kilometres or more.

showEpochAge.label: Show Epoch Age Badge
showEpochAge.helpText: Warn when the simulation time is more than 3 days from the selected satellite's element epoch.
